verdict.rationale: Any public-facing government website could publish an llms.txt or agent-oriented docs, so this axis applies. The evidence pack shows no llms.txt or agent docs for Nevada Secretary of State. The probes only show bot walls (Akamai 403 and Incapsula interstitials) at robots.txt on both nvsos.gov and esos.nv.gov/orion.nv.gov, which leaves no documented agent-readable entry point.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
